r06:
sequenceDiagram
  participant C as Client
  participant P as Platform HTTP entry
  participant R as Configured HTTPS route
  C->>P: HTTP /configured-redirect
  P-->>C: 308 to HTTPS, same host and path
  Note over C,P: Platform responds before the configured route
  C->>R: HTTPS /configured-redirect
  R-->>C: 301 to /probe
  Note over C,R: Separate redirect, not an override of the 308
